record.original_question: Consider the following properties of the generation A of a C0 -semigroups (T (t))t≥0 . (i) rg A closed. (ii) rg(1 − T (t)) closed for one t > 0. Does assertion (ii) imply assertion (i)?

evidence.quote: Problem 25 (Closedness of ranges). Consider the following properties of the generation A of a C0 -semigroups (T (t))t≥0 . (i) rg A closed. (ii) rg(1 − T (t)) closed for one t > 0. Does assertion (ii) imply assertion (i)?

artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a 2024 compilation of unsolved problems in one-parameter operator semigroup theory (collected from OPSO conferences 2021–2024). There is no published resolution found in the search results, so the implication is listed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in one-parameter operator semigroups theory
status_evidence.snippet: A collection of open problems in semigroup theory proposed by participants of OPSO conferences 2021-2024 which have not been solved yet.
status_evidence.claim: The closedness-of-ranges question for C0-semigroup generators is listed among currently unsolved problems in one-parameter operator semigroups theory.
